plotting_nb_figure_5

Marliette Matos

# ============================================================
# Setup
# ============================================================

# Load masked paths from config.
# Set FIGURE5_CONFIG=/path/to/config_figure5.R if the config is not in
# the current working directory.
source("config.local.R")
stopifnot(exists("paths_figure5"))
paths <- paths_figure5

if (!is.null(paths$r_libs)) {
  .libPaths(paths$r_libs)
}

setwd(paths$plot_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(data.table)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(IRanges)
  library(BSgenome)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(gridExtra)
  library(readr)
  library(BPCells)
  library(scales)

})
